what: audit log queryable only if you already know the ticket UUID
note: REPRODUCED as ops.head@fsm.test 2026-09-02. The ONLY audit read route is GET /api/audit-trail/tickets/:ticketId. Every listing shape 404s at the router: /audit-trail, /audit-trail/tickets, /audit-logs, /audit, /audit-trail/search, /audit-trail/actors. The ticket route requires a UUID (/audit-trail/tickets/all -> 400 INVALID_TICKET_ID), so there is no way in without already holding the number. Every filter param is SILENTLY IGNORED, not rejected: ?actorId=, ?actedAsRole=, ?actingZone=, ?from=&to=, ?entityType= each returned HTTP 200 with a byte-identical unfiltered body — the controller declares no @Query at all. An OH cannot ask 'what did this CSM do today' or 'show every acted-as action in zone 4'. CORRECTION to the S2 row: the claim 'the index at schema.prisma:1733 exists with no query behind it' is WRONG. role-backup.service.ts:89 groupBy(['actingZone','actedAsRole']) does read it, exposed at GET /api/reports/csm-approval-share (role-backup.controller.ts:60, @Roles OPERATIONS_HEAD) with a live admin page at /reports/csm-approval-share and a nav entry (nav.ts:215). But that reader is a per-zone COUNT roll-up returning {zoneId,csmActions,totalActedActions,sharePct} — it cannot reach a single row, so the ledger claim stands on its own evidence. Walked: month 2026-09 -> 1 zone, 2026-08 and 2026-07 -> 5 zones each, totalActedActions 1..4, so acted-as rows with a non-null actingZone DO exist in this DB (H5 confirmed: the write path is exercised, only the read side is missing). csmActions is 0 in every zone of every month walked. FOLDED IN (was going to be its own row): six controllers hardcode actedAsRole:null AND actingZone:null instead of calling auditActor() — cross-zone.controller.ts:113, devices.controller.ts:131, engineers.controller.ts:254, leave-request.controller.ts:69/85/103 — so a genuine acted-as session on devices, engineers, leave and cross-zone loses its attribution at write time and can never appear in either reader.
